functions.renderTaskCard: (task) -> the HTML string of one board card. Return the same string for the same task: the board rewrites a column only when its HTML changes.
functions.renderSessions: () -> rebuilds the session list in the sidebar. It returns early while the user drags or types in the list.
functions.renderKanban: () -> rebuilds the three board columns from currentTasks.
functions.renderActivityChip: () -> {waiting, active, terminal}: counts the sessions in each state and redraws the chips above the session list when the counts change. It runs on every session poll.

events.sessions.rendered: After each renderSessions call, also one that returned early.
events.activity.rendered: After each renderActivityChip call, with its {waiting, active, terminal} counts as the detail. A waiting session also counts as active.

parts.sidebar: The sidebar: header, session list, footer.
parts.board: The board with its three columns.
parts.session-card: One session in the session list, with data-session-id.
parts.sidebar-footer: The footer under the session list. Its children are rebuilt on each poll; the element stays.
parts.progress: The track of the progress bar in the session header.
parts.progress-fill: The fill inside progress, whose width is the share of the session's tasks done.
parts.kanbot: The Kanbot mascot, a 16x13 svg whose head is x 3-13 at the top row. It sits in the sidebar footer's button and in the Kanbot panel's head.
parts.idle-mascot: The mascot over the empty state, an svg.clawd that floats up and down.
parts.task-card: One card on the board, with data-task-id and data-session-id.
parts.task-number: The #id label at the top left of a task card.
parts.done-title: The title of the Completed column.

session-card.active: While it is the open session.
